description: Two adjacent verbatim image recipes claim the same uncovered comma in a,b. Their different input spans conflict, so emission ends with a grammar error (engine §11.1).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | comma
%rule letter "a" | "b" %emits $ :: L

%rule comma ","
```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($a:v $b:v) %emits $a :: A, $b :: B

%rule v :- $.verbatim-text | L

```
